cards.art: elderly woman whispering complaints into man's ear
cards.lore: This chat means 500 to 1,000 destructive words; principal topics being lack, failing sickness.
cards.name: THE OLD-FASHIONED CHAT
cards.power: Deplete target player's Willpower by 500 points per minute.

cards.art: man in suit holding smiling mask over blank face
cards.lore: A mask for the collective psyche... a compromise between individual and society.
cards.name: THE PERSONA
cards.power: Assume the identity of a generic NPC to avoid combat.

cards.art: shabby man straightening tie outside velvet rope
cards.lore: Tried to look rich while feeling poor... seeing two powers instead of one.
cards.name: THE COUNTERFEIT FACE
cards.power: Bluff into VIP lounge; fail immediately.

cards.art: suited man bellowing into megaphone, brain visible through skull
cards.lore: Thinking being under repression and relatively infantile... colourless and dry.
cards.name: THE EXTROVERT
cards.power: Shout over opponents until they agree.

cards.art: grim reaper mother-figure hovering over child in bed
cards.lore: Mother-fear is responsible for many of the diseases and accidents...
cards.name: THE MOTHER-FEAR
cards.power: Project illness onto target by worrying.

cards.art: towering patriarch with crown pointing downward at small child
cards.lore: Parental power guides the child like a higher controlling fate.
cards.name: THE FATHER-IMAGO
cards.power: Override free will with "Because I said so."

cards.art: green-tinted colleague stabbing flowers at coworker's desk
cards.lore: False growths are caused by jealousy, hatred, unforgiveness, fear, et cetera.
cards.name: THE JEALOUS COLLEAGUE
cards.power: Manifest tumor on opponent's action pile.

cards.art: woman's silhouette melting into suited man's shadow
cards.lore: A woman dissolving into her husband's psychology... contained in the husband.
cards.name: THE UNCONSCIOUS WIFE
cards.power: Become invisible next to male character.

cards.art: giant red lips shouting glowing letters that shatter records
cards.lore: I now speak and demolish by my spoken word; every untrue record in my subconscious mind.
cards.name: THE SPOKEN WORD
cards.power: Destroy one history card in play.

cards.art: sun wearing sunglasses exploding from industrial pipes
cards.lore: Sun-energy. God is our own longing to which we pay divine honors.
cards.name: THE LIBIDO

cards.art: man dodging boomerang spinning back at him in a storm of flies
cards.lore: Man's boomerangs of hate, resentment and criticism, come back laden with sickness and sorrow.
cards.name: THE BOOMERANG
cards.power: Reflect all damage back to dealer.

cards.art: sleeping figure on cloud, coins falling that dissolve on contact
cards.lore: The dream is a wish-fulfilment... replacing reality by archaic surrogates.
cards.name: THE WISH-FULFILMENT

cards.art: battered purse spilling coins that transform into golden light
cards.lore: Spending money to make money... the alchemical transmutation.
cards.name: THE MAGIC PURSE
cards.power: Spend all currency to double luck stat.

cards.art: pointed finger boring into object producing sparks
cards.lore: Act of boring with forefinger: an infantile presexual activity... discovery of fire.
cards.name: THE BORING FINGER

cards.art: woman staring at faint ladder outline materializing in her path
cards.lore: Fear attracted the ladder on the woman's pathway and fearlessness removed it.
cards.name: THE INVISIBLE LADDER

cards.art: primitive fire-stick with police silhouette in background smoke
cards.lore: Friction creating libido... The fire-preparation regarded as forbidden... as robbery.
cards.name: THE FIRE-STICK

cards.art: wealthy woman buried to the neck in clutched possessions
cards.lore: The woman's arms were gradually becoming paralyzed from holding on to things.
cards.name: THE HOARDER

cards.art: person facing inward while world swirls outside window frame
cards.lore: Depreciation of the external world... feelings being more or less repressed remain undeveloped.
cards.name: THE INTROVERT

cards.art: cracked record spinning failure scenes in its grooves
cards.lore: Old bad records in the subconscious mind... native nothingness.
cards.name: THE RESENTMENT RECORD
cards.power: Force opponent to replay last failure.

cards.art: writer typing furiously while ghost whispers in ear from behind
cards.lore: Unconscious plagiarism... a cryptomnesic conglomeration emanating, not from my brain at all.
cards.name: THE CRYPTOMNESIA

cards.art: man's silhouette detaching and acting independently behind him
cards.lore: The dark twin... primitive trends... repressed and concealed.
cards.name: THE SHADOW

cards.art: colossal foot beside tiny grasshopper-man in suit
cards.lore: And there we saw the giants and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers.
cards.name: THE GIANT OF DOUBT

cards.art: dragon-mother consuming glowing artifacts to heal wounds
cards.lore: Filled their bellies with poison... Furious gigantic lizards... Tiamat, our mother.
cards.name: THE TERRIBLE MOTHER

cards.art: man's head swarming with tiny insect-aliens of doubt
cards.lore: The adverse thoughts of doubt and fear... the army of the aliens.
cards.name: THE ARMY OF ALIENS

cards.art: muscular sun-hero wrestling a dragon, brain visibly shrinking
cards.lore: The sun-hero... wandering sun-heroes... Wahrohamusch (pale-boy human?).
cards.name: THE HERO (SUN-GOD)

cards.art: translucent muse-woman leading man toward cliff edge
cards.lore: Ghostly, seductive muse... Soul-image... projected upon the object.
cards.name: THE ANIMA
cards.power: Charm opponent; force them into danger.

cards.art: Adam and Eve at law table beneath apple tree made of illusion smoke
cards.lore: A belief in two powers, good and evil... Adam and Eve ate of maya the tree of illusion.
cards.name: THE FALSE LAW
cards.power: Create false rule for one turn.

cards.art: multi-armed goddess holding ornate key at crossroads gate
cards.lore: Lilith/Hecate... with a key... The key belongs to Hecate, guardian of Hades.
cards.name: THE DEMON-WOMAN

cards.art: two figures pulling steering wheel in opposite directions in one body
cards.lore: Inward dissociation... conflict between the individual psyche and the collective psyche.
cards.name: THE SPLIT MIND

cards.art: preacher holding burning trophy labeled LOSS above crowd labeled VICTORY
cards.lore: If I have a failure, I baptize it success, in the name of the Father!
cards.name: THE NEGATIVE CAPABILITY

cards.art: painted cardboard sun on stick above moon on wire over a game board
cards.lore: The sun and moon appear, but they are only made artificially from oil paper.
cards.name: THE SCHIZOPHRENIC SUN
cards.power: Reveal board as fake; reshuffle reality.

cards.art: man screaming at bank vault door while it physically seals shut
cards.lore: Imperative that he raise $50,000... came to me in despair... bank had flatly refused.
cards.name: THE $50,000 DOLLAR PANIC
cards.power: Panic so hard the bank closes.

cards.art: Vitruvian man with circuitry paths labeled Destiny, Purpose, Potential
cards.lore: A perfect idea in divine mind awaiting man's recognition... let the genius within me be released.
cards.name: THE DIVINE DESIGN

cards.art: ornate mandala floating in storm, player sheltered inside
cards.lore: The circle of sanity... the unity of difference... symbol of the absolute unconscious.
cards.name: THE MANDALA

cards.art: square diagram with heart, coin, rose, and microphone at each corner
cards.lore: The square of life: Health, Wealth, Love and Perfect Self-Expression.
cards.name: THE PERFECT SQUARE
cards.power: Max all stats for one round.

cards.art: tightrope bridge over chasm between two clashing card-worlds
cards.lore: A bridge over the abyss... a transition from the one attitude to the other...
cards.name: THE TRANSCENDENT FUNCTION

cards.art: water droplet slowly cutting through granite boulder
cards.lore: Water is the most powerful element, because it is perfectly non-resistant... wear away a rock.
cards.name: THE NON-RESISTANT WATER

cards.art: hero bursting from whale's mouth surrounded by water and light
cards.lore: Coming out of the whale's belly... slipping out of the hero... new fertility springs.
cards.name: THE REBIRTH

cards.art: diverse figures in golden chain, one redirecting their energy upward
cards.lore: Every man is a golden link in the chain of my good.
cards.name: THE GOLDEN LINK

cards.art: figure offering glowing card on altar while opponents kneel
cards.lore: Sacrifice of the horse; sacrifice of the animal nature... sacrifice of the infantile personality.
cards.name: THE SACRIFICE

cards.art: person buying armloads of blankets in sunshine
cards.lore: I'll dig my ditches by buying the blankets!... Active faith.
cards.name: THE BLANKETS
cards.power: Prepare for event that hasn't happened.

cards.art: three kings digging ditches in desert that fill with gold from nowhere
cards.lore: Ditches dug by the three kings... filled to over-flowing.
cards.name: THE DITCHES
cards.power: Create capacity for loot you don't have.

cards.art: ornate key with nose leading down dark corridor toward glowing door
cards.lore: The Key will scent the true place... 'Twill lead thee to the Mothers.
cards.name: THE KEY

cards.art: brain-shaped ropes tying themselves into infinite knot
cards.lore: Binding together... Entangles us in webs of dreams.
cards.name: THE KNOTS

cards.art: dignified donkey bearing two overloaded packs, moving very slowly
cards.lore: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens.
cards.name: THE ASS

cards.art: green serpent entering open mouth of sleeping figure
cards.lore: The snake represents the introverting libido... creeping into the mouth.
cards.name: THE GREEN SNAKE

cards.art: massive whale jaw consuming card-player in mid-action
cards.lore: The belly of the whale is clearly the land of death.
cards.name: THE WHALE

cards.art: stork in doctor coat delivering wrapped bundle labeled PROBLEM
cards.lore: The stork-theory... The unconscious meaning of the child's wish.
cards.name: THE STORK

cards.art: bearded professor gesturing wildly at exploding alphabet letters
cards.lore: A bearded figure speaking nonsense... Glossolalia.
cards.name: BLÖDSINN!

cards.art: two people conversing with flowers blooming from their speech bubbles
cards.lore: Talk about what we want, not what we don't want.
cards.name: NEW-FASHIONED CHAT

cards.art: open mouth streaming alien symbols crashing into opponent's speech bubbles
cards.lore: Rudimentary glossolalia... Martian language.
cards.name: GLOSSOLALIA

cards.art: woman throwing boomerang that returns labeled YESTERDAY
cards.lore: Automatically the law of karma is set in action.
cards.name: KARMA
cards.power: Instant cause and effect this turn.

cards.art: whale-creature flood consuming the entire game board
cards.lore: Devouring flood... symbolizing the danger of entering into the mother of death.
cards.name: THE FLOOD

cards.art: figure reaping glowing gold rewards from field ripe with card tokens
cards.lore: Look on the fields, for they are ripe already to harvest.
cards.name: THE HARVEST

cards.art: cloaked figure splitting ground beneath winning player's fortress
cards.lore: The end of the hero by means of earthquake.
cards.name: THE EARTHQUAKE

cards.art: cosmic fire-brain igniting stacks of wood and paper
cards.lore: God's own longing... Fire-whirled... Fire-scattering.
cards.name: THE FIRE

cards.art: first-place and last-place figures mid-swap, mid-air
cards.lore: Everything meets with its opposite... the rational attitude turns into irrational.
cards.name: ENANTIODROMIA

cards.art: white square on black background, single figure bowing to camera
cards.lore: This is the square of life. The game completed.
cards.name: THE GAME COMPLETED

cards.art: tower collapsing into crowd of confused players
cards.lore: Epidemic of madness... The legend of the Tower of Babel turns out to be a tenable truth.
cards.name: APOCALYPSE

cards.art: headless figure reassembling itself while holding intact memory-cards
cards.lore: Whatever man voices, he begins to attract... The body may be renewed.
cards.name: THE RESURRECTION

title: Jung and Shinn: A Guide to Cosmic Cringe
